verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a bulk data export in open formats or an account-exit path. Port-in docs only cover moving numbers into Twilio. Event Streams and the general REST APIs are adjacent building blocks, not an export capability. Community reports also say Twilio made exporting Authy data extremely difficult.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
